title: More ways to use the text API
summary:
Two text options, a larger request limit, a community bot, and some less surprising behavior under the text API’s hood.

Added `openai-reasoning` for o1-mini and `hypnosis-tracy`, a self-help hypnosis persona. The OpenAI text request limit increased from 256,000 to 512,000 message characters.

Gacha joined the Social Bots listings with chat, web search, and character-aware image generation. Project repository links now point directly to their supplied URLs, and author names can link to profiles outside Discord.

OpenAI-style responses preserve existing IDs and creation timestamps, while Hugging Face requests use a lower output limit. Several text generators moved to a shared client, and SearchGPT can use an explicitly supplied model instead of always selecting `openai-large`.

highlights.title: o1-mini joins text
highlights.text: The new `openai-reasoning` option routes text requests to o1-mini. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

highlights.title: A hypnosis persona
highlights.text: `hypnosis-tracy` adds a self-help hypnosis persona backed by `openai-large`. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=hypnosis-tracy).

highlights.title: More room for text
highlights.text: OpenAI text requests can contain up to 512,000 message characters, up from 256,000. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Choose SearchGPT’s model
highlights.text: SearchGPT accepts an explicitly supplied model instead of always using `openai-large`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Meet Gacha bot
highlights.text: Gacha joined the Social Bots listings. It combines chat, web search, selectable image models, and character-aware images through `!webgen`. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
